# Included libraries

- Three.js 0.180.0: upstream build/three.module.js, build/three.core.js, and examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js. MIT license; full license in three/LICENSE.txt. https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- GSAP 3.13.0: upstream dist/gsap.min.js, including its original copyright/license header. License information: https://gsap.com/standard-license/ and https://gsap.com. No modification to the distribution file.

All library files in this directory were retrieved from their version-pinned npm distributions through jsDelivr. The app serves them locally rather than fetching them from a third-party CDN at runtime.
